Field
Description
StorageUsageInfo
Information containing mount points used space (GB) & available space (GB) for each individual logical drive/volume and formatted in the
following format:
"[version],[mount point of first volume/drive record]|[used space in GB]|[available space in GB],[mount point of second volume/drive record]|
[used space in GB]|[available space in GB],[mount point of third volume/drive record]|[used space in GB]|[available space in GB]"
